Container.Name: honcho-aio
Container.Overview:
Honcho is memory infrastructure for agents that track people, sessions, and ideas over time. Store messages. Let it derive. Query context or search.
honcho-aio packages that for Unraid. One container. Honcho on port 8000. Postgres and Redis inside, not on the LAN. Set a password and <provider>/<model> strings. Then hermes memory setup → http://<lan>:8000.
First run: 1. Set PostgreSQL Password (required). The container exits 64 if it is empty. 2. Set EMBEDDING_MODEL and CHAT_MODEL as <provider>/<model>. Split is on the first /. Nested model slashes stay (openrouter/openai/gpt-5.4-mini). 3. If you use local/, set LOCAL_BASE_URL (example http://192.168.1.79:11434/v1). Local chat has no cloud fallback. 4. Fill only the API key for the provider you picked. 5. Start, then point Hermes with: hermes memory setup → http://<lan>:8000
The chat model must support tool/function calling. At boot the image probes embedding width. A mismatch with EMBEDDING_VECTOR_DIMENSIONS fails boot.

Container.ExtraSearchTerms: honcho memory agent postgres pgvector redis hermes
Container.Requires: Docker. A LAN IP you control. Optional: a local OpenAI-compatible embed/chat endpoint for local/ models.
Container.Description: Honcho is memory for stateful agents. It stores messages, reasons in the background, then returns context, search, and peer conclusions. honcho-aio runs that stack as one image: Honcho API, PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, Redis, and s6. Databases stay on loopback. Point Hermes at http://<lan>:8000. No MCP.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Honcho API port. Postgres and Redis stay inside the container.

Config.Name: Postgres Data
Config.Description: Internal PostgreSQL 17 data. Not published to the LAN.

Config.Name: Redis Data
Config.Description: Internal Redis data. Not published to the LAN.

Config.Name: Honcho State
Config.Description: Honcho runtime.env and generated state.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Container exits 64 if empty. Masked.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL User
Config.Description: Internal Postgres user.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Internal Postgres database name.

Config.Name: Embedding Model
Config.Description: Format <provider>/<model>. Split on first /. Examples: local/embeddinggemma, openai/text-embedding-3-small.

Config.Name: Chat Model
Config.Description: Format <provider>/<model>. Nested slashes stay (openrouter/openai/gpt-5.4-mini). Must support tool calling.

Config.Name: Local Provider Base URL
Config.Description: Required for local/ models. Example: http://192.168.1.79:11434/v1. Local chat has no cloud fallback.

Config.Name: Embedding Vector Dimensions
Config.Description: Must match the model output width. Boot fails on mismatch. 768 for embeddinggemma.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Used for openai, openrouter, and together.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Used when CHAT_MODEL uses anthropic/. Chat only.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Used when EMBEDDING_MODEL or CHAT_MODEL uses gemini/.

Config.Name: Ollama API Key
Config.Description: Default ollama. Used when provider is ollama/.

Config.Name: Local Provider API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Needed only if the local OpenAI-compat endpoint requires a key.

Config.Name: Enable Authentication
Config.Description: Set true to enable JWT auth on the Honcho API.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Optional static JWT secret. Empty means generate on first boot.

Config.Name: Enable Metrics
Config.Description: Set true to expose /metrics.

Config.Name: Enable Telemetry
Config.Description: Set true to send anonymous Honcho usage telemetry.

Config.Name: Enable Sentry
Config.Description: Set true to send errors to Sentry. Needs SENTRY_DSN.

Config.Name: Sentry DSN
Config.Description: Sentry DSN. Required only when SENTRY_ENABLED is true.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret for signed Honcho webhooks.

Config.Name: Deriver Workers
Config.Description: Concurrent deriver workers. Default 4.

Config.Name: LLM Log Level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

Config.Name: Namespace
Config.Description: Honcho namespace. Isolates agent memory.
